channel.title: Juan Manuel Ruiz Muñoz – ML Engineer · Computer Vision & LLMs
channel.description: ML Engineer specialized in Computer Vision and LLMs: industrial defect detection, LoRA-tuned multimodal OCR and RAG systems in production. Physicist and mathematician. Projects, publications and blog of Juan Manuel Ruiz Muñoz.

item.title: vcalib: differentiable calibration filters for RF-DETR under illumination shift
item.description: A ~2 KB filter, fitted label-free in minutes on a CPU, gives a frozen detector back the activations and the mAP it loses when the lighting changes.

item.title: Misinformation detection in fiction works with LLM-generated ontologies
item.description: An LLM + RAG architecture, published at DCAI'25, that builds a verified ontology incrementally and uses it to flag false claims in films, podcasts and texts.
